title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models : Open X-Embodiment Collaboration0
venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
tldr: Pools demonstrations from 22 robot types across 21 labs into one standardized dataset and trains RT-1-X/RT-2-X generalist policies that transfer across embodiments.
relevance_reason: Context: the dominant pretraining corpus most efficient VLAs train or evaluate on.

title: Motus: A Unified Latent Action World Model
tldr: A mixture-of-transformers model that switches between world-model, VLA, inverse-dynamics and video-generation modes, learning latent actions from optical flow.
relevance_reason: Context: widely cited unified world-action model baseline.

title: What Matters in Learning from Offline Human Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation
tldr: Large empirical study of offline imitation/RL algorithms on simulated and real multi-stage manipulation with human demos, released as the robomimic benchmark.
relevance_reason: Context: robomimic benchmark used throughout diffusion-policy efficiency work.

title: Mobile ALOHA: Learning Bimanual Mobile Manipulation with Low-Cost Whole-Body Teleoperation
tldr: Low-cost whole-body teleoperation rig for bimanual mobile manipulation; shows co-training with static ALOHA data greatly boosts ACT-style policies.
relevance_reason: Context: standard low-cost platform and dataset for ACT/chunking policies.

title: GR-2: A Generative Video-Language-Action Model with Web-Scale Knowledge for Robot Manipulation
tldr: Generalist manipulation agent pretrained on tens of millions of internet video clips, then fine-tuned for joint video generation and action prediction.
relevance_reason: Context: major video-pretrained robot foundation model.

title: DreamVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Dreamed with Comprehensive World Knowledge
tldr: VLA that forecasts compact dynamic, spatial and semantic world knowledge before predicting actions via inverse dynamics.
relevance_reason: Context: frequently used world-model-augmented VLA baseline.

title: Survey of Vision-Language-Action Models for Embodied Manipulation
tldr: Survey of VLA models for manipulation covering architectures, datasets, pre-/post-training and evaluation, with deployment challenges.
relevance_reason: Context survey of VLA landscape.

title: Robotic Control via Embodied Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
tldr: Trains VLAs to produce grounded multi-step reasoning (plans, subtasks, object boxes) before acting, improving generalization.
relevance_reason: Context: reasoning-VLA baseline whose inference cost motivated later efficient-reasoning work.

title: DiT4DiT: Jointly Modeling Video Dynamics and Actions for Generalizable Robot Control
tldr: Cascades a video diffusion transformer with an action DiT, conditioning actions on intermediate denoising features instead of full reconstructed frames.
relevance_reason: Context: prominent video-action model cited by several core items.

title: Learning Transferable Dynamics Priors from Action to World Modeling
tldr: Pretrains a multi-view action-conditioned diffusion world model (A2World) and adapts it both into a policy-evaluation simulator and a video-action policy.
relevance_reason: Context: action-conditioned robot world model foundation.

title: Vision Language Action Models in Robotic Manipulation: A Systematic Review
tldr: Systematic review of ~100 VLA models, their datasets and simulation platforms with a taxonomy of architectures.
relevance_reason: Context review of VLA models and benchmarks.

title: Navigation World Models
tldr: Controllable video world model (CDiT, up to 1B params) that predicts egocentric observations from navigation actions and is used to plan/rank trajectories.
relevance_reason: Context: widely used navigation world model.

title: 3D Diffuser Actor: Policy Diffusion with 3D Scene Representations
tldr: Diffusion policy with a 3D relative-position denoising transformer over scene features; SOTA on RLBench and CALVIN.
relevance_reason: Context: standard 3D diffusion-policy baseline.

title: ElegantVLA: Learning When to Think for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 13.8 Hz -> 26.3 Hz control frequency on real GR00T tasks; up to 2.55x (GR00T) / 3.77x (CogACT) speedup
tldr: Plug-in scheduler that decides per control step how much of the vision encoder, LLM and action-head denoising to recompute versus reuse, accelerating VLAs without retraining.
relevance_reason: Directly about VLA inference acceleration with measured control-rate gains.

title: InternVLA-A1.5: Unifying Understanding, Latent Foresight, and Action for Compositional Generalization
tldr: Distills video-generator dynamics priors into a few latent foresight tokens during training and discards the video branch at inference to keep real-time control.
relevance_reason: World-model benefits without inference-time video generation cost.

title: InternVLA-M1: A Spatially Guided Vision-Language-Action Framework for Generalist Robot Policy
tldr: Two-stage VLA recipe: large-scale spatial grounding pretraining followed by spatially prompted action post-training.
relevance_reason: Context: open generalist VLA used as a baseline.

title: χ0: Resource-Aware Robust Manipulation via Taming Distributional Inconsistencies
reported_metric: ~20 h data, 8 A100 GPUs for training
tldr: Resource-aware recipe (weight-space merging, stage-aware advantage, train/deploy alignment) giving robust long-horizon dual-arm garment manipulation from modest data and compute.
relevance_reason: Framed around resource efficiency: 20 h of data and 8 A100s to beat pi0.5.

title: ContextVLA: Vision-Language-Action Model with Amortized Multi-Frame Context
tldr: Compresses past observations into a single context token so a VLA gets multi-frame benefits with reduced training and inference time.
relevance_reason: Token compression for efficient temporal context in VLAs.

title: Dual-Stream Diffusion for World-Model Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model
tldr: Multimodal diffusion transformer with separate state and action streams and decoupled noise, plus asynchronous action/vision sampling for inference-time scaling.
relevance_reason: Context: world-model-augmented VLA cited by several core items.

title: World Tokens: Enhancing Embodied Policies with Training-Time World Modeling
tldr: Uses a future-video denoiser only during training to shape world tokens consumed by the action expert, then removes it so chunks are produced at VLA-level latency.
relevance_reason: Efficient-deployment design for world-model-enhanced VLAs.

title: EveryDayVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Pairs a sub-$300 6-DoF arm with a VLA outputting discrete and continuous actions, using uncertainty-triggered re-planning for safe operation.
relevance_reason: Low-cost deployment of robot foundation models with uncertainty-driven replanning.

title: GigaBrain-0: A World Model-Powered Vision-Language-Action Model
tldr: VLA foundation model trained heavily on world-model-generated data (video generation, sim2real, view transfer) with RGB-D input and embodied CoT.
relevance_reason: Context: major VLA foundation model.

title: Beyond Imitation: Self-Improving Robot Policies via Off-Policy Q-Planning
tldr: Adds a small Q-function to a large frozen BC policy for value-weighted action selection and online improvement that only updates the Q-function.
relevance_reason: Efficient adaptation of large robot policies without updating policy weights.

title: VideoVLA: Video Generators Can Be Generalizable Robot Manipulators
tldr: Turns a pretrained video generation DiT into a VLA that jointly predicts future frames and action sequences.
relevance_reason: Context: video-generator-as-policy baseline cited by core items.

title: FAITH-Manip: A Benchmark for Offline-to-Closed-Loop Evaluation of Imitation-Learning Robotic Manipulation Policies
venue: 2026 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Robotics (CISR)
tldr: Benchmark measuring how faithfully offline proxies (validation loss, open-loop error) predict closed-loop success across DP, ACT and VLA policies.
relevance_reason: Benchmarking methodology for robot policies.

title: Data Scaling Laws in Imitation Learning for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Large real-robot study showing policy generalization follows power laws in the number of environments and objects.
relevance_reason: Context: data-scaling reference for robot policies.

title: Dream-VL & Dream-VLA: Open Vision-Language and Vision-Language-Action Models with Diffusion Language Model Backbone
tldr: Builds a VLM and VLA on a diffusion-LLM backbone whose bidirectional decoding suits parallel action-chunk generation and speeds fine-tuning convergence.
relevance_reason: Alternative non-autoregressive backbone enabling parallel action generation.

title: RoboTwin: Dual-Arm Robot Benchmark with Generative Digital Twins
tldr: Generative digital-twin framework producing dual-arm manipulation data and a sim/real-aligned benchmark.
relevance_reason: Context: RoboTwin benchmark widely used for VLA evaluation.

title: From Foundation to Application: Improving VLA Models in Practice
tldr: LingBot-VLA 2.0 scales pretraining to ~60k hours, expands the action space to whole-body DoFs and adds predictive dynamics as a proxy task.
relevance_reason: Context: industrial VLA foundation model.

title: GigaWorld-0: World Models as Data Engine to Empower Embodied AI
tldr: World-model framework combining video generation and 3D generative/physics modules to synthesize embodied training data for VLAs.
relevance_reason: Context: world-model-as-data-engine platform.

title: AHA: A Vision-Language-Model for Detecting and Reasoning Over Failures in Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Open VLM fine-tuned on procedurally generated failure trajectories to detect and explain manipulation failures.
relevance_reason: Runtime failure detection (C7 monitoring).

title: Interactive Language: Talking to Robots in Real Time
tldr: Real-time language-instructable robot framework with a ~600k-trajectory language-labeled dataset and benchmark.
relevance_reason: Context: Language-Table dataset/benchmark.

title: Memory as Plans: World-Action Modeling with Memory-Grounded Planning
tldr: Converts episodic memory into compact plans so the world-action executor keeps a fixed context length with KV caching, holding inference latency constant as history grows.
relevance_reason: Latency-bounded memory design for world-action models.

title: FIERCE: From Generalist Robot Policies to Fast Specialists via Progress-Failure Feedback
tldr: Refines compact specialist policies from a generalist initialization with RL driven by a learned progress/failure evaluator; only the specialist is deployed.
relevance_reason: Distilling generalist competence into cheap-to-deploy specialists.

title: Ordered Action Tokens for Visuomotor Policy Learning
tldr: Learned action tokenizer with ordered, prefix-decodable tokens giving an anytime trade-off between inference cost and action fidelity.
relevance_reason: Action tokenization with explicit compute/fidelity trade-off.

title: ROBOTURK: A Crowdsourcing Platform for Robotic Skill Learning through Imitation
tldr: Crowdsourcing platform for 6-DoF teleoperated demonstration collection via smartphones.
relevance_reason: Context: data-collection platform underlying robomimic-style datasets.

title: Moto: Latent Motion Token as the Bridging Language for Learning Robot Manipulation from Videos
venue: IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision
tldr: Learns discrete latent motion tokens from videos, pretrains an autoregressive model over them, then maps to robot actions.
relevance_reason: Context: latent-action tokenization baseline cited by several core items.

title: BAKU: An Efficient Transformer for Multi-Task Policy Learning
tldr: Simple multi-task transformer combining observation trunks, action chunking and action heads for data-efficient policy learning.
relevance_reason: Context: lightweight multi-task policy baseline.

title: DynamicManip: Enabling Dynamic Manipulation from a Single Static Demonstration
tldr: Synthesizes dynamic-manipulation demos from one static demo and uses a policy that adapts its inference frequency to task dynamics.
relevance_reason: Latency-aware control for dynamic manipulation.

title: Training Agents Inside of Scalable World Models
tldr: Scalable world-model agent whose world model runs real-time interactive inference on a single GPU, enabling offline RL in imagination (Minecraft diamonds).
relevance_reason: Efficient, real-time world model for imagination-based policy learning.

title: Scaling Cross-Embodied Learning: One Policy for Manipulation, Navigation, Locomotion and Aviation
tldr: Transformer policy trained on 900K trajectories from 20 embodiments that controls arms, wheeled robots, quadrupeds and drones with one set of weights.
relevance_reason: Context: cross-embodiment generalist policy.

title: A Taxonomy for Evaluating Generalist Robot Manipulation Policies
tldr: Proposes a fine-grained taxonomy (STAR-Gen) of generalization axes with reproducible guidelines for evaluating generalist manipulation policies, with real-world case studies.
relevance_reason: Benchmarking methodology for generalist robot policies.

title: Video2Act: A Dual-System Video Diffusion Policy with Robotic Spatio-Motional Modeling
tldr: Uses a video diffusion model as a slow System 2 providing motion-aware conditions to a fast DiT action head that runs asynchronously.
relevance_reason: Asynchronous dual-system design to address VDM inference inefficiency.

title: Bidirectional Decoding: Improving Action Chunking via Closed-Loop Resampling
tldr: Title indicates a test-time resampling scheme to make action chunking more closed-loop (no abstract available).
relevance_reason: Action chunking vs. reactivity, core C1/C7 topic.

title: KoopmanFlow: Spectrally Decoupled Generative Control Policy via Koopman Structural Bias
tldr: Splits generation into a single-step consistency branch for slow motion and a flow-matching branch for high-frequency corrections within real-time budgets.
relevance_reason: Few-step generative policy designed for real-time receding-horizon control.

title: PRM-as-a-Judge: A Dense Evaluation Paradigm for Fine-Grained Robotic Auditing
tldr: Evaluation paradigm using process reward models to score progress, efficiency and stability of robot rollouts from video instead of binary success.
relevance_reason: Benchmarking methodology beyond success rate.

title: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
reported_metric: ~0.7% of OpenVLA-OFT parameters while outperforming it by 18%
tldr: Lets small transformer policies consume dense pretrained ViT patch tokens with block-causal attention, avoiding a billion-parameter VLM backbone.
relevance_reason: Lightweight alternative to VLAs with large parameter savings.

title: Critical Interval MSE: Toward Reliable Offline Validation for Robot Manipulation Policies
tldr: Offline validation metric restricting action error to task-critical segments to better predict real-world policy performance.
relevance_reason: Benchmarking methodology for policy selection.

title: MARS Policy: Multimodality Only When It Matters
tldr: Invokes stochastic multimodal generation only in phases that need it and uses deterministic prediction elsewhere, cutting inference cost.
relevance_reason: Directly reduces generative-policy inference latency.

title: L1 Sample Flow for Efficient Visuomotor Learning
tldr: Reformulates flow matching as sample prediction with an L1 loss, needing only two network evaluations per action sequence.
relevance_reason: Few-step flow policy for faster inference and training.

title: BridgeVLA: Input-Output Alignment for Efficient 3D Manipulation Learning with Vision-Language Models
tldr: 3D VLA that projects point clouds to multi-view images and predicts 2D heatmaps, aligning inputs and outputs with the VLM for sample-efficient learning.
relevance_reason: Context: sample-efficient 3D VLA cited by several core items.

title: 4D-VLA: Spatiotemporal Vision-Language-Action Pretraining with Cross-Scene Calibration
tldr: Adds depth and temporal cues to VLA inputs to align robot and scene coordinates, improving pretraining efficiency.
relevance_reason: Context: VLA pretraining method cited by core items.

title: Diffusion-VLA: Generalizable and Interpretable Robot Foundation Model via Self-Generated Reasoning
tldr: Combines autoregressive reasoning with a diffusion action head; smallest 2B model reports high inference rate and trains from few demos.
relevance_reason: Reports explicit inference-rate numbers for a reasoning VLA.

title: EVOLVE-VLA: Test-Time Training from Environment Feedback for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Test-time training framework letting VLAs keep adapting through environment interaction with few or no task demos, using learned progress feedback.
relevance_reason: Efficient deployment-time adaptation of VLAs.

title: Lifting Embodied World Models for Planning and Control
tldr: Composes a frozen world model with a lightweight policy mapping high-level to low-level actions, making planning cheaper in high-dimensional action spaces.
relevance_reason: Reduces world-model planning cost.

title: PredVLA: Predictive Sensorimotor Modeling for Sub-Million-Parameter Robot Manipulation
tldr: Language-conditioned predictive-coding policy with 0.68M trainable parameters and no robot pretraining, competitive on LIBERO.
relevance_reason: Extreme model-size reduction for manipulation policies.

title: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation
tldr: Diagnostic contract and evaluation for whether action-conditioned world models behave like faithful physical simulators.
relevance_reason: Benchmarking methodology for world models.

title: HALO-WA: Hybrid-Attention Latent-Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for World-Action Models
tldr: Online RL with a lightweight adapter reading world-action-model latents for fast real-world adaptation on precision tasks.
relevance_reason: Efficient online adaptation of WAMs.

title: Failure Identification in Imitation Learning Via Statistical and Semantic Filtering
tldr: Policy-independent failure detector using optimal-transport anomaly scores with conformal thresholds and VLM semantic filtering.
relevance_reason: Runtime failure monitoring (C7).

title: RhinoVLA Technical Report
tldr: Deployment-oriented VLA co-designed with an edge SoC, cutting VLM token load and using compilation and mixed precision to reach real-time on-device control.
relevance_reason: Onboard edge deployment with hardware co-design.

title: FPC-VLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework with a Supervisor for Failure Prediction and Correction
tldr: Pairs a VLA with a VLM supervisor that predicts failures and issues corrections, plus a fusion module refining actions.
relevance_reason: Runtime failure prediction and correction (C7).

title: A hierarchical approach to imitation learning for manipulation tasks requiring time varying forces
reported_metric: 5 Hz high level / 60 Hz low level
tldr: Decouples a 5 Hz diffusion planner from a 60 Hz lightweight force-conditioned controller to handle contact transients despite diffusion latency.
relevance_reason: Addresses diffusion-policy latency for high-rate contact control.

title: Real-Time Video Generation with Pyramid Attention Broadcast
tldr: Training-free acceleration of DiT video generation by reusing attention outputs across diffusion steps.
relevance_reason: Foundational efficiency technique for video world models.

title: Diffusion Models Are Real-Time Game Engines
tldr: Diffusion model simulating DOOM interactively in real time over long trajectories.
relevance_reason: Real-time interactive world model reference.

title: ManipArena: Comprehensive Real-world Evaluation of Reasoning-Oriented Generalist Robot Manipulation
tldr: Standardized real-robot evaluation framework (20 tasks, paired real-to-sim scenes) for VLA and world-action policies under matched physical conditions.
relevance_reason: Benchmarking methodology for embodied foundation models.

title: From Pretraining to Proficiency: Real-World Subtask RL for Long-Horizon Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention
tldr: Real-world residual RL that concentrates practice on bottleneck subtasks of a frozen foundation policy, needing only tens of minutes of rollouts.
relevance_reason: Sample-efficient real-world RL fine-tuning of foundation policies.

title: Learned Image Compression for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Learned image codec that allocates bitrate by task relevance so VLAs keep control performance under tight bandwidth in distributed/remote deployment.
relevance_reason: Edge-cloud communication efficiency for VLAs.

title: ProbeAct: Probe-Guided Training-Free Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Training-free runtime layer that probes VLA features, detects grasp/place failures and applies a hierarchical CBF filter to correct actions.
relevance_reason: Runtime monitoring and safety filtering (C7).

title: Vidarc: Embodied Video Diffusion Model for Closed-loop Control
tldr: Autoregressive embodied video diffusion with a masked inverse-dynamics model and cached generation for fast closed-loop control.
relevance_reason: Latency reduction for video-diffusion policies.

title: SCALE: Self-uncertainty Conditioned Adaptive Looking and Execution for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Training-free inference strategy that modulates perception and action by self-uncertainty in a single forward pass, replacing costly multi-pass test-time scaling.
relevance_reason: Test-time scaling without extra inference passes.

title: SaiVLA-0: Cerebrum-Pons-Cerebellum Tripartite Architecture for Compute-Aware Vision-Language-Action
reported_metric: training time 7.5 h -> 4.5 h with split feature caching
tldr: Frozen-backbone VLA with an adapter and fast parallel decoder plus feature caching; concept paper with preliminary timing evidence.
relevance_reason: Compute-aware VLA architecture.

title: stable-worldmodel: A Platform for Reproducible World Modeling Research and Evaluation
tldr: Open platform with fast data loading, baselines, planners and controlled-variation environments for reproducible world-model evaluation.
relevance_reason: Benchmarking infrastructure for world models.

title: DiWA: Diffusion Policy Adaptation with World Models
tldr: Fine-tunes diffusion policies entirely offline with RL inside a learned world model, needing orders of magnitude fewer physical interactions.
relevance_reason: Efficient adaptation of diffusion policies via world models.

title: I-FailSense: Towards General Robotic Failure Detection with Vision-Language Models
tldr: VLM-based failure detector with lightweight heads on internal layers for semantic-misalignment failures.
relevance_reason: Runtime failure detection (C7).

title: StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation
tldr: Distills teacher-VLM reasoning into a lightweight student VLM for fast stage-transition decisions in hierarchical control.
relevance_reason: Distillation for low-latency runtime monitoring.

title: AT-VLA: Adaptive Tactile Injection for Enhanced Feedback Reaction in Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Adds a fast tactile control stream beside the slow VLM stream so a VLA reacts to touch in real time.
relevance_reason: Dual-rate design addressing VLA inference latency.

title: Normalizing Flows are Capable Models for Bi-manual Visuomotor Policy
tldr: Normalizing-flow visuomotor policy with single-pass sampling and tractable likelihoods, giving faster training and lower latency than diffusion.
relevance_reason: Computationally efficient generative policy class.

title: AWM-VLA: AlignedWorld Modeling for Efficient and Explainable Vision-Language-Action Policies
tldr: Embeds world modeling in a diffusion-transformer policy via a few future-aligned tokens rather than pixel prediction, adding little cost.
relevance_reason: Cheap world-model integration without pixel generation.

title: MoIRA: Modular Instruction Routing Architecture for Multi-Task Robotics
tldr: Routes tasks to LoRA-adapted VLA experts (GR00T-N1, pi0) via zero-shot text routing for low-overhead modular deployment.
relevance_reason: Parameter-efficient modular experts.

title: π0-EqM: Equilibrium Matching for Closed-Loop Vision-Language-Action Control
tldr: Replaces pi0's flow-matching expert with an equilibrium-matching decoder allowing state-dependent compute and temporal reuse across control cycles.
relevance_reason: Inference-depth as a design knob for VLA action heads.

title: Efficient Evaluation of Multi-Task Robot Policies With Active Experiment Selection
tldr: Frames robot policy evaluation as active testing, choosing informative trials to cut evaluation cost.
relevance_reason: Evaluation-cost methodology (C4).

title: Behavior Uncloning: Distilling Mode Redirection into Policy Weights without Inference-Time Steering
tldr: Distills inference-time mode redirection into policy weights via a short 'uncloning' step, avoiding steering overhead at deployment.
relevance_reason: Removes inference-time steering overhead for safe behavior.

title: Action Chunking and Exploratory Data Collection Yield Exponential Improvements in Behavior Cloning for Continuous Control
tldr: Theory showing action chunking and exploratory data collection avoid exponential compounding errors in imitation learning.
relevance_reason: Theoretical grounding for action chunking.

title: ZeroQuant: Efficient and Affordable Post-Training Quantization for Large-Scale Transformers
tldr: End-to-end post-training quantization pipeline for large transformers with fine-grained hardware-friendly schemes and layer-wise KD.
relevance_reason: Foundational quantization technique cited by core items.

title: Safe, Task-Consistent Manipulation with Operational Space Control Barrier Functions
venue: IEEE/RJS International Conference on Intelligent RObots and Systems
tldr: Operational-space CBF safety filters for manipulators that enforce many constraints cheaply while keeping task consistency.
relevance_reason: Real-time safety filtering (C7).

title: Finite Scalar Quantization: VQ-VAE Made Simple
tldr: Replaces VQ codebooks with simple per-dimension scalar quantization, matching VQ performance without codebook collapse.
relevance_reason: Foundational tokenization technique used by action tokenizers.

title: DeepSeekMoE: Towards Ultimate Expert Specialization in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
tldr: MoE design with fine-grained and shared experts for better specialization at fixed compute.
relevance_reason: Foundational MoE technique.

title: StrataVLA: Hierarchical and Efficient 3D Geometric Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Injects frozen geometry-model features into selected VLA layers and uses routing plus an LRU cache to cut geometry-model calls.
relevance_reason: Efficiency-aware 3D grounding for VLAs.

title: Hyper-DP3: Frequency-Aware Right-Sizing of 3D Diffusion Policies for Visuomotor Control
reported_metric: <1% of parameters of prior 3D diffusion policies; two-step inference
tldr: Shows action denoising saturates after few steps and builds a tiny 3D diffusion policy with two-step DDIM inference.
relevance_reason: Model right-sizing and few-step sampling for diffusion policies.

title: RAFAIL: Relationship-Aware Failure Detection for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Detects execution failures via OOD detection on task-relevant relationships, avoiding VLM inference at runtime.
relevance_reason: Low-overhead runtime failure detection.

title: AutoVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Adaptive Reasoning and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
tldr: Driving VLA with fast (trajectory-only) and slow (CoT) modes, using RL fine-tuning to skip unnecessary reasoning.
relevance_reason: Adaptive reasoning to cut inference cost in an embodied VLA.

title: Guided Streaming Stochastic Interpolant Policy
tldr: Derives optimal guidance for streaming stochastic-interpolant policies, enabling reactive real-time steering unlike chunk-based policies.
relevance_reason: Low-latency reactive generative control.

title: MambaVLA: A Scalable and Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model with State Space Architecture
tldr: VLA built on a Mamba state-space backbone with flow-matching actions, matching transformer VLAs at lower compute and faster inference.
relevance_reason: Efficient backbone architecture for VLAs.

title: Effective Tuning Strategies for Generalist Robot Manipulation Policies
venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
tldr: Empirical study of fine-tuning design choices for adapting generalist manipulation policies with limited samples.
relevance_reason: Efficient adaptation recipes (C3).

title: Few-Shot Vision-Language Action-Incremental Policy Learning
tldr: Formulates few-shot action-incremental learning and proposes a task-prompt graph policy for continual learning with few demos.
relevance_reason: Few-shot continual adaptation (C3).

title: Ground Slow, Move Fast: A Dual-System Foundation Model for Generalizable Vision-and-Language Navigation
tldr: Dual-system VLN model: a VLM plans waypoints slowly while a lightweight DiT policy produces fast trajectories.
relevance_reason: Dual-system design for real-time embodied control.

title: Q-VLM: Post-training Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models
tldr: PTQ framework for large VLMs that searches rounding strategies accounting for cross-layer dependencies.
relevance_reason: Foundational VLM quantization technique.

title: RAIL: Reachability-Aided Imitation Learning for Safe Policy Execution
venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
tldr: Studies enforcing hard safety constraints on IL policies with reachability-aided filtering.
relevance_reason: Safety filtering for learned policies (C7).

title: EAGLE: Speculative Sampling Requires Rethinking Feature Uncertainty
tldr: Speculative sampling that drafts at the feature level to accelerate LLM decoding.
relevance_reason: Foundational speculative-decoding technique.

title: LLM-QAT: Data-Free Quantization Aware Training for Large Language Models
venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
tldr: Data-free QAT for LLMs using self-generated data for distillation, enabling lower bit-widths.
relevance_reason: Foundational quantization technique.

title: A scalar per patch from pre-trained ViTs enables fast moving navigation in the real world
tldr: Large real-world navigation study of visual encoders showing distilled, heavily bottlenecked (one scalar per patch) features suffice for fast navigation.
relevance_reason: Compact visual representations for fast embodied control.

title: PaCo-VLA: Passivity-Shielded Compliance Prior for Contact-Rich Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
tldr: Treats low-rate VLA outputs as compliance proposals checked by a high-frequency passivity shield that blocks stale or invalid predictions.
relevance_reason: Safety under low VLA output rates (C7).

title: SkiP: When to Skip and When to Refine for Efficient Robot Manipulation
tldr: Relabels free-space segments so the policy leaps over redundant steps and refines only key contact segments.
relevance_reason: Reduces executed decision steps.

title: Shifting Uncertainty to Critical Moments: Towards Reliable Uncertainty Quantification for VLA Model
tldr: Uncertainty aggregation for VLAs that preserves short risk spikes to better predict rollout failures.
relevance_reason: Runtime monitoring (C7).

title: EBT-Policy: Energy Unlocks Emergent Physical Reasoning Capabilities
reported_metric: 2 inference steps vs 100 for Diffusion Policy (50x fewer) on some tasks
tldr: Energy-based transformer policy that beats diffusion policies with less training/inference compute, sometimes converging in two steps.
relevance_reason: Compute-efficient generative policy class.

title: MoRE: Unlocking Scalability in Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Vision-Language-Action Models
venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
tldr: Quadruped VLA with multiple LoRA experts as a sparse MoE, fine-tuned with RL on mixed-quality data.
relevance_reason: Parameter-efficient adaptation (C3).

title: RAF-VLA: Representation Alignment with the Future for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
tldr: Aligns driving-VLA hidden states with future-frame features from a world encoder, avoiding the cost of explicit future generation.
relevance_reason: Gets world-model benefits with negligible inference overhead.

title: A Frame is Worth One Token: Efficient Generative World Modeling with Delta Tokens
reported_metric: 35x fewer parameters and 2,000x fewer FLOPs than existing generative world models; 1,024x token reduction at 512x512
tldr: Encodes frame-to-frame feature changes as one token per frame, enabling a far smaller and cheaper generative world model.
relevance_reason: Directly about world-model efficiency.

title: The Matrix: Infinite-Horizon World Generation with Real-Time Moving Control
tldr: Real-time controllable world simulator generating continuous 720p video streams.
relevance_reason: Real-time interactive world model.

title: Token Reduction Should Go Beyond Efficiency in Generative Models - From Vision, Language to Multimodality
tldr: Argues token reduction in generative models should serve goals beyond efficiency across vision, language and multimodal models.
relevance_reason: Foundational token-reduction perspective cited by core items.

title: Safety filtering of robotic manipulation under environment uncertainty: a computational approach
tldr: Physics-simulation safety filter that densely rolls out nominal parameters and sparsely re-evaluates critical transitions under uncertainty.
relevance_reason: Safety filtering (C7).

title: RB2: Robotic Manipulation Benchmarking with a Twist
tldr: Ranking-based benchmarking protocol that trades off reproducibility and accessibility across labs.
relevance_reason: Real-robot benchmarking methodology (C4).

title: Memory as a Wasting Asset: Pricing Flash Endurance for Embodied Agents, and the Limits of Doing So
tldr: Prices flash write endurance for on-board robot memory and derives cost-optimal RAM/NVM/cloud placement.
relevance_reason: Hardware-aware resource analysis for edge robots.

title: FlexEE: Self-Speculative and KV-Compatible Early Exiting for Offloading-Aware LLM Inference
tldr: Early-exit framework compatible with KV caching and self-speculation for offloading-based LLM inference.
relevance_reason: Foundational early-exit technique.

title: Learning New Tasks via Reusable Skills: Skill-Compositional Experts for Embodied Continual Learning
tldr: Continual learning via reusable skill experts to add tasks without forgetting under closed-loop control.
relevance_reason: Continual adaptation (C3).

title: Humanoid World Models: Open World Foundation Models for Humanoid Robotics
tldr: Lightweight open humanoid world models trainable on 1-2 GPUs, with parameter-sharing that shrinks models.
relevance_reason: Resource-efficient world models.

title: BiKC+: Bimanual Hierarchical Imitation With Keypose-Conditioned Coordination-Aware Consistency Policies
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
tldr: Hierarchical bimanual IL with a keypose predictor and a one-step consistency trajectory generator for fast inference.
relevance_reason: One-step generative action decoding.

title: PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control
reported_metric: 16.79 ms median / 19.38 ms p95 callback (< 20 ms control period)
tldr: Predictive state-action diffusion policy for humanoids, optimized to run within the control period on an onboard Jetson and deployed on a Unitree G1.
relevance_reason: Onboard real-time diffusion control with measured latency.

title: VFP: Variational Flow-Matching Policy for Multi-Modal Robot Manipulation
tldr: Variational flow-matching policy with OT alignment and MoE decoder capturing multi-modality while keeping fast inference and compact size.
relevance_reason: Efficient flow policy.

title: Time-Unified Diffusion Policy with Action Discrimination for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Time-unified denoising velocity field that speeds up diffusion-policy action generation, with larger gains at fewer iterations.
relevance_reason: Faster diffusion-policy inference.

title: LOTUS: Continual Imitation Learning for Robot Manipulation Through Unsupervised Skill Discovery
venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
tldr: Continual IL that grows a skill library from few demos while avoiding forgetting.
relevance_reason: Continual adaptation (C3).

title: Lifelong Imitation Learning with Multimodal Latent Replay and Incremental Adjustment
tldr: Lifelong IL that replays compact multimodal latents instead of raw data, under memory and data constraints.
relevance_reason: Memory-efficient continual adaptation.

title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
tldr: Interactive world model with bounded-memory attention and LoRA-based distillation to four sampling steps for real-time streaming.
relevance_reason: Efficient real-time world model with bounded memory.

title: nuQmm: Quantized MatMul for Efficient Inference of Large-Scale Generative Language Models
tldr: Quantized matrix-multiplication kernels for efficient inference of large generative LMs (no abstract available).
relevance_reason: Foundational quantization technique cited by core items.
